envelope.description: Add exact cancellation and preparation progress surfaces

body.title: Add exact cancellation and preparation progress surfaces
body.summary: Extend worker control and both public MCP/daemon surfaces plus supported IPC DTOs for cancellation and bounded genuine preparation counters. Implement the private host-to-worker bridge for the main-owned per-project capacity allocator, runtime store and context registry; retain exact per-review allocation ownership across worker reclamation and release only after proven file cleanup.
acceptanceChecks: Exact owner-only cancel prevents new work, stops only selected worker, reports honest resource fences; polling creates no activity; both clients agree with enums.
Cancel/spawn/candidate/publication races preserve exact ownership and already committed results; progress counters reflect genuine completed operations only.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

Private worker ports bind capacity/runtime/context requests to the exact current review owner and phase; workers cannot instantiate separate project allocators or mint context/runtime authority. Test the bridge before t12 activation.

tests.name: Extend worker isolation/progress/recovery and MCP wire fixtures: cancel exact review during preparation/tool/model/publication races, owner rejection, resource fence and nullable genuine counters.
Private preparation bridge tests: exact worker/review ownership, aggregate project capacity, split/combine allocation retention, context/runtime receipts, worker reclamation and cleanup-only release.
